ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Funding Issues in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the reasons behind the delay in Medicaid funding in Minnesota and its impact on low-income families.
questions: What is causing the delay in Medicaid funding?
How are low-income families affected by this delay?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues in the Medicaid funding process and highlight the human impact on low-income families. I recommend starting with public records requests and interviewing state officials.

ideas.title: Exposing Child Care Fraud Nationwide
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of child care fraud across the United States and highlight cases of corruption and abuse.
questions: What are the most common types of child care fraud?
How can policymakers prevent child care fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a critical issue affecting young children and their families. I recommend starting with data analysis and interviewing experts in the field.
